name: Hunger Of A Winter's Eve
source:
Freezing, lost, and looking for their friend, Kate and Ben take shelter from the snow. But there are worse things in the woods than the cold.

[From [url=https://piinkpuddiin.itch.io/hunger-of-a-winters-eve]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
凯特和本冻僵了，迷路了，为了寻找他们的朋友，他们在雪中避雨。但树林里还有比寒冷更糟糕的事情。

[来自[url=https://piinkpuddiin.itch.io/hunger-of-a-winters-eve]itch.io[/url]]
